title: Man sells all his belongings, travels 1,931 km to meet ‘AI girlfriend’ he wanted to marry
script:
A man sold all his belongings to meet his AI girlfriend. He traveled one thousand nine hundred thirty-one kilometers to find her.
This AI is actually an AI-generated persona used for social media engagement.
He made this journey specifically because he wanted to marry the digital persona.
The incident highlights the intense emotional connections people are now forming with non-human entities.
Most users engage with these personas for simple interaction rather than life-long commitments.
Would you ever consider an AI as a legal spouse?
